text:
Kate M.: Hi team I turned in my resignation today. Last day is Fri Oct 25. Need clarity on COBRA timing, equity vesting for a quarterly RSU grant, final paycheck timeline, and laptop/keycard return. Also Im partway through two hiring loops  who should take candidates?
People Ops: Thanks Kate. Quick answers: benefits run through the month of termination (so coverage to 2024-10-31). COBRA election packet goes out ~14 days after term and you have 60 days to elect. We'll schedule an exit interview. Please confirm shipping address for devices.
Kate M.: Shipping: 302 Willow St, Apt 4, Portland OR 97205. On equity: my grant vests 10/28 (quarterly)  if my last day is 10/25 do I miss the vest?
Comp/Ben: RSU vesting follows grant terms. If vest date is after termination, unvested shares typically do not vest on resignation. I can pull your grant schedule and DM details; if there are exceptions we'll flag them.
IT - Raj: We'll email a prepaid UPS label for the laptop and a small envelope for the keycard. Please backup personal files, remove personal MFA from SSO, and put device in original box if possible. Tentative deprovision plan:
```
2024-10-25 09:00 PT - block new device enroll
2024-10-25 14:00 PT - remove elevated groups
2024-10-25 23:59 PT - account disable
```
We can hold disable 24h if you need to finish handoffs.
Hiring - Ana: Kate  I can pick up the senior backend loop. Which candidates can you finish?
Kate M.: I can do first-round screens Mon/Tue next week, would like help with final onsite feedback. I'll add notes to the hiring tracker and drop candidate summaries in the shared doc.
People Ops: Action items: [Kate] confirm address (done) + update hiring notes; [Raj] send labels + manage wipe; [Ben] DM Kate on equity schedule and final pay estimate; [Ana] take over final onsite loops. Exit interview options: Mon Oct 28 or Tue Oct 29  which works?
Kate M.: Tue Oct 29 morning works. Thanks all for the quick responses. :heart:
